Name: Tool Belt Slots Advanced
Author: Dtron0102
Description:
[size=5][b]Tool Belt Slots Advanced[/b][/size]

A separate belt just for your tools, so they stop filling your toolbar and backpack. For Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI.

[list]
[*]10 tool slots above your toolbar.[/*]
[*]Tools on the belt use no backpack space.[/*]
[*]Everything can be changed in the settings.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Belt[/b]: 10 slots drawn just above your toolbar.[/*]
[*][b]Keys 1-0[/b]: take a belt tool into your hands. The mouse wheel still picks your toolbar items.[/*]
[*][b]Auto return[/b]: scroll or click away and the tool goes back on the belt.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory column[/b]: the belt shows beside your inventory. Drag tools on and off it.[/*]
[*][b]New tools[/b]: bought, found or upgraded tools go straight onto the belt.[/*]
[*][b]Safe saving[/b]: the held tool goes back on the belt before the day ends or the game saves.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
In config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu: the key for each slot, whether weapons count as tools, and whether new tools go to the belt.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], then unzip into your Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]
Type [b]toolbelt_empty[/b] in the SMAPI console first, then save. Your belt tools go back into your backpack.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Don't use it with Grandpa's Toolbelt or other tool belt mods.[/*]
[*]Made for single player. Not tested in multiplayer.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: A tools-only belt above your toolbar with its own storage. Number keys 1-0 put a belt tool in your hands without using any backpack slot.
